caption: The drawing depicts a single long-stemmed pipe rendered in shades of brown and tan, with detailed shading to suggest a wooden texture. The pipe's bowl is sculpted in the form of a human head wearing a tricorn hat, with facial features clearly defined and a visible ear on the right side. The hat is styled to suggest a historical or military figure. Along the stem of the pipe, there are decorative elements, including a small shield and a rectangular section with the word "NEW YORK" written on it. In the top right corner, there is a smaller, separate depiction of the pipe's bowl, focusing on the face and hat from a frontal perspective, showing the opening at the top for the tobacco, and emphasizing the hat's shape and facial features. The background is plain, off-white with slight discoloration and some spots.
title: Pipe
